correctness.rationale: In RESULT.md the exact affine sector flow has barycentric beta(z)=z-(C/a)s(1-e^{-az}) and alpha(z)=1-z+(C/a)s+(E/a)s e^{-az}, with a=lambda L^2/omega>0, b=mu Delta/omega>=0, C=a/2+b, E=a/2-b. For -1<s<1/C, beta strictly increases and alpha crosses zero exactly once with negative derivative; the exit radius F=s e^{-az} satisfies log|s/F|=a+Cs+EF and the positive-derivative Lambert W0 branch constraint 1+EF>0. Then 0<|F|<|s|, F'(0)=exp(-a), cycle period N/omega and transverse multiplier exp(-Na). The u=1+s origin limit has the three separately verified E<1 linear, E=1 square-root and E>1 positive-ejection branches; the result expressly excludes the origin and global switching uniqueness. Independent numerical checks of initial-to-exit identities, times and transversality passed 96 independently selected parameter/section cases. Proof supplies all-parameter statement; finite checks do not.
